reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as an Ethereum earning opportunity in which viewers pay 25,000 or 50,000 rupees to activate slots, recruit people across twelve slots, and pursue greater profit and passive income. It directs viewers to participate through a referral URL, WhatsApp group, contact number, and “JOIN NOW” prompt while displaying a “$1,000,000 Profits” claim.

citations.quote: We are promoting our business to a higher level by taking risk.
Referral link https://forsage.io/i/kabxbv/
If we activate both slots, we will get more profit wherever we start our business.
We can activate people who are with us for as much as we want, in our 12 slots.

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker explicitly says the business involves risk; that is difficult to reconcile with a claim that the video promises a certain return. The discussion also makes the coin's value conditional, saying what could happen if its price rises. Read the income discussion as speculative investment commentary, not a guaranteed payout.

citations.quote: We are promoting our business to a higher level by taking risk.
If 25,000 becomes 75,000, the value of this coin will be maximum.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening identifies slot prices and a referral link, but neither establishes that the quoted returns are guaranteed or explains the payout formula. Even the cited statement about greater profit is conditional on activating both slots. The speaker's acknowledgment of risk matters when deciding whether the pitch represents income as certain.

citations.quote: If we activate both slots, we will get more profit wherever we start our business.
We are promoting our business to a higher level by taking risk.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Acknowledging risk does not turn this into detached market analysis. The speaker promotes activating slots for greater profit, describes activating other people within twelve slots, and points viewers to a referral link. Those are concrete features of the opportunity being promoted, regardless of whether an exact payout formula is given.

opening.argument: Judge, much of the presentation explains blockchain, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and how the speaker says this platform operates. The sampled interface displays numbered tiers and amounts, while the speaker directs listeners to a scheduled presentation. That combination supports reading the video as an explanation of a system people can examine, rather than proof that viewers are being deceived.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited referral URL and invitation to join establish that viewers can follow up; they do not, by themselves, make every explanation of the interface deceptive. The opening also treats activating people in slots as a complete account of how money flows, though that sentence gives no payout rule.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The technical introduction does not change the video's purpose. The speaker ties activating slots to greater profit and describes activating other people in twelve slots; a visible join prompt and the referral link give viewers ways to act on that pitch. Explaining an interface can be part of promoting the opportunity.

citations.quote: If we activate both slots, we will get more profit wherever we start our business.
We can activate people who are with us for as much as we want, in our 12 slots.
Referral link https://forsage.io/i/kabxbv/

opening.argument: Judge, a referral link and a promotion are not enough to establish a fraudulent recruitment scheme. The speaker discusses buying a coin and sharing the opportunity with others, and describes people activating priced slots. The supplied material does not show a transaction record, a contract, or a rule specifying that earlier participants are paid from later participants' payments. The narrower conclusion is that this is a referral-based business promotion whose precise payment mechanism is not established here.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening reasonably flags the combination of profit, slots, and referrals, but it goes further by treating that combination as an established payout mechanism. The cited twelve-slot statement says people can be activated; it does not state who pays whom or on what terms. The displayed profit figure likewise cannot verify actual returns.

citations.quote: We can activate people who are with us for as much as we want, in our 12 slots.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An exact transfer rule is not necessary to recognize what is being promoted. The speaker says activating both slots brings more profit, describes activating other people across twelve slots, and reports monetary slot activations. That is more specific than an ordinary referral discount or a simple coin purchase.
